name: slide-tool
description: Marp + Tailwind でスライドを Markdown から作る（レイアウト集・チェック・PDF / PPTX 出力）

scripts.html: npm run theme && marp --input-dir slides --output dist
scripts.pdf: npm run theme && marp --input-dir slides --output dist --pdf
scripts.pptx: npm run theme && marp --input-dir slides --output dist --pptx
scripts.catalog: npm run theme && marp layouts/catalog.md --output dist/catalog.html && marp layouts/catalog.md --output dist/catalog.pdf --pdf
scripts.check:overflow: npm run theme && marp --input-dir slides --output build/check --template bare && marp layouts/catalog.md --output build/check/catalog.html --template bare && node scripts/check-overflow.mjs build/check
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:overflow
